name: Mbare Musika
subtitle: Mbare Musika is a fresh produce market in the Mbare area of Harare.

facts.label: Origins
facts.value: Built by African farmers and traders, especially women

facts.label: Municipal recognition
facts.value: Salisbury Municipality recognised African markets in the 1940s

parts.text: Mbare Musika is a fresh produce market in the Mbare area of Harare. A 2023 University of Pretoria thesis traces it from 1930 and credits African farmers and traders, especially women, with building it.
